# Important Information
📌 Please check the FAQ and announcements before opening a ticket, your answer might already be there.
ℹ️ **Please explain your issue fully and clearly so staff can help you quickly.**

### ⚠️ Please read before opening a ticket
1️⃣ If you're reporting a **bug**, use the bug reports forum instead.
2️⃣ If you're reporting a **player**, include their username and any clips or screenshots you have.
3️⃣ If you're asking about **data or a purchase**, include your Roblox username and roughly when it happened.

**Opening tickets for no reason, or spamming them, may get you blocked from support.**
